notes: V9.0.1 adds WellView Job Time Log operation notes to Post Frac TOC extraction. It recognizes entries such as TOC at 4950', links time-log rows to completion jobs and reports, supports current and legacy WellView views, and excludes unrelated drilling-job TOC values. It also keeps tubing and ESP geometry aligned with the well trajectory on four-string designs and uses the final sustained survey build for KOP.
